paragraphs.text: Arine was a friend of Liliana Vess in her youth. She lived at Vess Manor along with Lady Ana and Liliana's parents and her brother Josu Vess .

Arine was a friend of Liliana 's and alerted the young healer of the arrival of the battlefield caravan to Vess Manor. Liliana had been spending an amorous moment with a boy in a back room when Arine interrupted them to deliver the news that Liliana's brother Josu had been struck by a mage-blade and was in dire need of healing.

When Liliana later turned Josu into a zombie without intending to, the whole household was struck by a curse. It can be assumed that Arine died in the following surge of death magic, along with the rest of the entire household.
